notes: 4-tier ladder from the approved plan, expressed entirely as data so scripts/run_unknown_campaign.py
never hardcodes a recipe. Tier 1 points at real, already-existing checkpoints/pools and is safe to
dispatch as-is (CPU, grouping_deploy.py only). Tiers 2-4 need: (a) data/pools/v2/... manifests from
the camp-splits agent (task #8, in progress at write time -- partial output already exists under
data/pools/v2/), (b) GPU free (currently busy with other training -- CPU-only rule applies), and
(c) a per-tier metrics adapter that maps grouping_deploy.py/offline_summary.json (and whatever the
perf-* leaderboard agents emit) into the evaluate_gate() schema documented in run_unknown_campaign.py.
Known open item: scripts/train_contrastive_ddp.py has no --seed CLI flag (SEED=42 is a module
constant) -- Tier 2's 'seeds: [1,2,42]' is recorded in the registry for provenance but will not
actually vary the seed until that flag is added; do not claim seed-diversity from this config alone.

tiers.name: existing_model_direct_predict
tiers.description: Frozen FCMAE backbone + current 2-seed projection-head ensemble, zero-shot. Lowest-risk operating point.

tiers.name: current_best_recipe_retrain
tiers.description: Frozen FCMAE, proj128/ep20/batch64/sampling0.25/temp0.20/queue16384/ignoreNeg0.72/local0.5/lrHead1e-3/wd1e-6, seeds 1/2/42, label-free epoch pick.

recipe.wd: 1e-6 (not CLI-overridable in train_contrastive_ddp.py -- module constant, provenance only)
recipe.seed_note: SEED is a module constant (=42) in train_contrastive_ddp.py; no --seed flag exists yet. Recorded here for registry provenance -- does not yet vary the run.

steps.name: select_epoch_label_free
steps.description: Wire to scripts/label_free_gate.py once per-epoch embeddings are exported (bootstrap_stability/coherence/noise/fragmentation, no labels). Placeholder command -- fill in --frozen-embedding/--adapted-embedding paths once tier2 training lands.

tiers.name: recipe_and_grouping_sweep
tiers.description: 1-seed/4-epoch pilot (10 cells) -> top4 full 20ep -> top2 3-seed. HDBSCAN dial grid on cached embeddings (validation only, no re-training). Temporal threshold sweep. Wafer 4-dataset shortlist then HF 3-dataset transfer check.
tiers.selection_note: The runner does not auto-rank pilot cells -- inspect runs/campaign_registry.jsonl for the 10 pilot records (tier=3, step name matches a pilot_cells[].name), pick the top 4 by the label-free gate (coherence/bootstrap-stability/noise/fragmentation, scripts/label_free_gate.py), add 4 explicit tier-3 steps at 20 epochs, then top 2 at 3 seeds. This keeps an untested auto-selection heuristic out of an unmanned multi-day loop.

cluster_sweep_grid.note: Validation-only, operates on already-embedded pools (no re-training) via grouping_deploy.py --mcs/--ms/--eps/--reassign/--method. Not auto-expanded into concrete steps yet -- do that once a tier-2 or tier-3 champion embedding exists to sweep over.

wafer_shortlist_then_hf_transfer.note: Pick 4 wafer datasets from the tier-3 result, then confirm the same recipe/dial transfers to hf_dtd/hf_flowers102/hf_resisc45 before promotion consideration.

tiers.name: cnn_tapt_then_sweep
tiers.description: known-cnn TAPT backbone init, same tier-3 sweep. Only promoted if it beats the frozen champion -- never demotes an already-set lower-tier champion regardless of its own gate result.
tiers.backbone_init_note: classified as type=cnn-tapt by scripts/campaign_checkpoint.py -- valid ONLY as --backbone/--cnn-run-dir init for scripts/train_contrastive_ddp.py, never as a grouping-predictor checkpoint. If retraining known-cnn itself is needed first, novel classes must stay excluded (known-train classes only).
